import asyncio
import random
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


class PathStore:
    factory = Path

    def read(self) -> str:
        return self.root.read_text()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.root = self.factory("state")


class LoopStore:
    runner = asyncio.Runner()

    def read(self) -> float:
        return self.loop.time()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.loop = self.runner.get_loop()


class GeneratorStore:
    factory = random.Random

    def reseed(self) -> None:
        self.generator.seed()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.generator = self.factory(7)


class TimeStore:
    factory = datetime

    def observed_at(self) -> float:
        return self.value.timestamp()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.value = self.factory(2026, 8, 23)
